column2: If willful ignorance is defined as being turned away from what one knows, its contrary is attending to that same knowledge.
An agent who does not know a thing can be neither turned away from it nor facing it in the sense of A-001.
Forgiveness, apology and restitution are not contraries of the wrongs they answer.
An agent who has never been in a condition can be in the condition contrary to it, but cannot be performing a remedy for it.
Lacking a gift that one was never given is not itself an orientation, and so is not the contrary of grace in the receptive sense.
